newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET DAY STABLE TO FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET DAY STABLE TO FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished Wednesday's interbank session stable on the U.S. dollar but posted slight gains against sterling, the mark and the rand, dealers said.
"It was a very quiet day. There were just a few import payments but there weren't (enough) to really move the market," commented one dealer.
The local unit closed at 11.2750/2850 against the key U.S. dollar, where it also ended on Tuesday, but firmed to 18.5020/5290 from 18.5500/5700 against sterling.
Against the mark it was slightly stronger at 6.7380/7470 from 6.7500/7700 and was at 2.5461/5500 from 2.5500/5650 versus the South African rand.
